QuestInfo.name: [Star Force] Straightening Time
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #p2041023#, who seems confused about how the Clocktower Bottom Floor has changed so drastically.\r\n
QuestInfo.1: #p2041023# says the only thing he can do now is take care of the Clocktower Bottom Floor. Eliminate #o6300100# and #o7140000# monsters hiding the time scattered by the fallen star and return time to normal.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the #o6300100# and #o7140000# monsters and restored time to how it should be, just as #p2041023# requested.\r\n

0.0: Oh dearie me. What would we have done? Who could've stopped a falling star? All we can do now is clean up the mess. But I can't do it alone. Will you help?\r\n

yes.0: Time has been scattered all over the place, thanks to that star. I'll bet those #r#o6300100##k and #r#o7140000##k monsters are hiding all the pieces of time. Defeat them and get them back!

no.0: This place is the heart of Ludibrium. You have to help!

1.0: Have you collected all the Lost Time?

yes.0: At least we can avoid the worst now. Imagine if there were no time. We'd have no present, past, or future. It's unimaginable! Unthinkable! Unspeakable!

default.0: I'll bet those #r#o6300100##k and #r#o7140000##k monsters are hiding all the pieces of time. Defeat them and get them back!
